tools.name: lookup_brand_recommendation_rate
tools.description: Look up a brand's AI Recommendation Rate: the percentage of buyer-intent questions where the brand is the #1 AI pick (not just mentioned), plus its Recommendation Inclusion Rate (appears anywhere in the answer). Returns the brand's public record URL and measured date for citation. Free, single-brand

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
